metadata.target_environments: Localhost / Hostinger cPanel Python / VPS Ubuntu

project_specification.system_role: You are an expert full-stack engineer and cybersecurity specialist. Your mission is to build, extend, or deploy 'SonicAttend', an air-gapped classroom attendance platform utilizing inaudible high-frequency acoustic sound (18.5 kHz - 19.8 kHz) and hardware device binding. Engineering standards: Maintain clean, modular code. Do NOT include robotic AI comments or repeated divider lines. Follow PEP-8 Python and clean modern JavaScript/HTML5 conventions.
project_specification.problem_statement: 1. Paper roll calls consume 10-15 minutes and allow proxy sign-ins. 2. Static QR codes are photographed and forwarded to absent peers via WhatsApp. 3. Biometric kiosks create doorway congestion and have hardware upkeep costs. 4. Bluetooth (BLE)/Wi-Fi signals penetrate walls (30-50m), enabling proxies from adjacent rooms or canteens. SonicAttend Solution: - High-frequency sound waves (>18 kHz) cannot penetrate solid brick walls, guaranteeing physical classroom presence. - Rotating TOTP tokens (15-second epoch) prevent replay attacks; VoIP audio codecs (Opus/AAC) cut frequencies above 16 kHz. - Cryptographic hardware fingerprinting permanently locks 1 student USN to 1 physical smartphone.

backend.security: HMAC-SHA256, SHA256 Password Hashing, Ephemeral Session Seeds
backend.wsgi_server: Passenger WSGI (Hostinger cPanel) / Gunicorn (Linux VPS) / Waitress (Windows)

frontend.styling: Tailwind CSS (CDN with form & container-queries plugins)
frontend.typography: Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono
frontend.audio_engine: HTML5 Web Audio API (OscillatorNode, GainNode, AnalyserNode, MediaStreamAudioSourceNode)
frontend.visualizer: HTML5 Canvas (2D FFT Spectral Curve & Sub-carrier LED Bars)

audio_parameters.grace_period: +/- 1 step (15s tolerance window for network latency)

layer_1.name: Remote Proxy Prevention
layer_1.threat: Student attempts check-in from hostel, canteen, or outside classroom.
layer_1.defense: High-frequency sound waves (>18 kHz) cannot penetrate concrete walls. VoIP/WhatsApp audio codecs (Opus/AAC) cut frequencies above 16 kHz, blocking remote audio streaming.

layer_2.name: Single-Device Multi-Account Prevention
layer_2.threat: One student carries one phone and logs into multiple accounts.
layer_2.defense: Cryptographic Device Binding: USN is tied to browser-generated UUID (DEV-XXXX). Unauthorized hardware signatures return HTTP 403 PROXY_REJECTED.

layer_3.name: Physical Device Smuggling Prevention
layer_3.threat: Student carries absent friend's physical phone to class.
layer_3.defense: 1. Ultrasonic Attenuation: Denim pocket/bag cloth absorbs 19 kHz waves (>20 dB loss). 2. Audio SNR Filter: SNR < 15 dB rejected with desk placement prompt. 3. Short 60s broadcast window. 4. Front camera liveness check.

table.name: students
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students ( usn TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, branch TEXT DEFAULT 'Computer Science & Engineering', semester TEXT DEFAULT '5th Sem', mobile TEXT NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, bound_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_name TEXT DEFAULT 'Pixel 8 (Registered Phone)', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

table.name: faculty
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS faculty ( faculty_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, mobile TEXT NOT NULL, department TEXT DEFAULT 'Dept of Computer Science & Engineering', designation TEXT DEFAULT 'Assistant Professor', subject TEXT DEFAULT 'CS501 - Machine Learning', password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

table.name: class_sessions
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS class_sessions ( session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, faculty_id TEXT NOT NULL, subject_code TEXT NOT NULL, subject_name TEXT NOT NULL, room_no TEXT NOT NULL, frequency_khz REAL DEFAULT 19.25, secret_seed TEXT NOT NULL, is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );

table.name: attendance_records
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance_records ( record_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, usn TEXT NOT NULL, student_name TEXT NOT NULL, subject_code TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, device_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_verified INTEGER DEFAULT 1, acoustic_token TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (usn) REFERENCES students(usn), FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES class_sessions(session_id) );

table.name: courses
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS courses ( course_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, course_name TEXT NOT NULL, faculty_name TEXT NOT NULL, faculty_id TEXT NOT NULL, room_no TEXT NOT NULL, credits INTEGER DEFAULT 4 );

table.name: timetable
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS timetable ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, day_of_week TEXT NOT NULL, period_no INTEGER NOT NULL, course_code TEXT NOT NULL, course_name TEXT NOT NULL, faculty_name TEXT NOT NULL, room_no TEXT NOT NULL, start_time TEXT NOT NULL, end_time TEXT NOT NULL, is_lab INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );

table.name: device_rebinding_tickets
table.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS device_rebinding_tickets ( ticket_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, usn TEXT NOT NULL, student_name TEXT NOT NULL, old_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, new_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'PENDING_HOD_APPROVAL', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (usn) REFERENCES students(usn) );

hostinger_deployment.cpanel_python_app: 1. In Hostinger hPanel, go to 'Setup Python App' and click 'Create Application'. 2. Set Python Version: 3.10/3.11, App root: public_html/sonicattend, App URL: your domain. 3. Set Startup file: passenger_wsgi.py, Entry point: application. 4. Upload project files (app.py, templates, static assets, sonicattend.db). 5. Create passenger_wsgi.py: import sys, os sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__)) from app import app as application 6. In configuration files, install: Flask>=3.0.0, Werkzeug>=3.0.0. 7. Enable SSL/HTTPS (Critical: Web Audio microphone API requires HTTPS on mobile devices). 8. Restart the Python application in hPanel.
hostinger_deployment.vps_ubuntu: 1. SSH to VPS: sudo apt update && sudo apt install python3-pip python3-venv nginx -y. 2. In /var/www/sonicattend: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install flask gunicorn. 3. Systemd /etc/systemd/system/sonicattend.service: [Unit] Description=SonicAttend Service After=network.target [Service] User=www-data WorkingDirectory=/var/www/sonicattend ExecStart=/var/www/sonicattend/venv/bin/gunicorn -w 3 -b 127.0.0.1:5000 app:app Restart=always [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target 4. Enable service: sudo systemctl enable --now sonicattend. Proxy through Nginx with Certbot SSL.

project_specification.execution_instructions: 1. Zero dummy data: Ensure all tables start clean or bind only verified university rosters. 2. Enforce bottom padding: All fixed toolbars must be paired with pb-44 on parent containers to avoid viewport clipping. 3. Keep code natural: Maintain clean developer comments, avoid heavy decorative divider lines. 4. Web Audio compatibility: Require user click gesture before initializing AudioContext on Chrome and Safari.
